criteria.text: A row for every fab session

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: One row for every session you worked on a part: the date, the part, the machine and what got done, written specifically enough that someone else could follow it.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One fab session has no row, or one row is too vague to follow ("worked on it").

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Two or more sessions have no row or are too vague to follow.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No log, or not a real attempt.

criteria.text: Problems recorded with what you did about them

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every problem written in the log says what you did about it. Sessions with no problem may leave the column blank.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: At least one problem is written down without what you did about it.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Problems the photos or notes show are missing from the log, or the log is missing.

criteria.text: Two photos: at the machine, and finished

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: One photo of your part on the machine (held for cutting, or partway through with the machine stopped) and one of the finished part. Both are sharp and clearly your part. Extra photos are welcome and never required.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One of the two is missing, blurry, or does not clearly show your part.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No photos, or photos of someone else's part.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names one specific thing about making this part on this machine: a setup that worked or did not, a feature that came out off, a step you would do differently.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A general statement that could describe anyone's part ("it went well", "the mill is hard").

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Missing or not a real attempt.

criteria.text: Two photos: at the machine, and finished

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: One photo of your part at the machine (held for cutting, the laser job loaded with the material in place, or partway through with the machine stopped) and one of the finished part. Both are sharp and clearly your part. Extra photos are welcome and never required.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: One of the two is missing, blurry, or does not clearly show your part.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No photos, or photos of someone else's part.

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Names one specific thing about making this part on this machine.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: A general statement that could describe anyone's part.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Missing or not a real attempt.

criteria.text: Prediction copied and three readings before any filing

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The designed value, tolerance and prediction match your Locked prediction on the Shop Fix Board, and three or more readings of that same dimension were taken before any filing, sanding or shimming.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: One value differs from the board, or the readings disagree by more than the tolerance with no remeasure.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Only one or two readings, or readings of a different feature.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Missing, or numbers that do not belong to this part.

criteria.text: The verdict and the parts together

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: The inside or outside call matches your readings against the designed value plus or minus the tolerance, and the photo shows both parts together at the interface.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: The call is wrong, or there is no photo of the parts together.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Missing.

blocks.prompt: What changed from your drawing or plan, and why

criteria.text: Every change from the drawing or plan, and why

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: Every difference between what you made and what you drew or planned is listed with the reason: a dimension, a machine, a step, a material, filing to fit. If nothing changed, it says so and how you know (you measured against the drawing).

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: Every change is listed, but at least one has no reason.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Changes are described vaguely ("I fixed some stuff"), or a change the photos show is missing.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: Missing or not a real attempt.

criteria.text: Installed where the problem was, and working

levels.label: Complete
levels.descriptor: A photo of the fix installed in the spot from your before photo, doing the job it was made for: the tool in the holder, the cable routed.

levels.label: Proficient
levels.descriptor: The fix is installed but not shown doing its job, or shown working somewhere other than the problem spot.

levels.label: Developing
levels.descriptor: Both parts are made and shown together, but the fix is not installed.

levels.label: Absent
levels.descriptor: No photo of the finished fix.
